item_fields_note: Every item needs key and title. STORIES are authored by `forge roadmap derive`, `forge roadmap import` and `forge roadmap add`, which additionally require epic (a known epic id), story, acceptance_criteria (non-empty list), skill (frontend|backend|fullstack), and depends_on (list of story keys; [] explicitly means no dependencies). derive/import also require spec as a repo-relative docs/specs/<slug>.md reference to a confirmed spec; add requires it unless --no-spec --reason records visible spec debt. EPICS are authored by `forge roadmap derive`, `forge roadmap import` and `forge roadmap epic add` — not by `roadmap add`, which only checks that the epic its story names already exists. Those three require id, title, objective, and source_refs that resolve inside the repo. `forge roadmap set-epic` points an existing story at a known epic. Stored roadmaps predating this contract stay readable: only authoring is checked, and forge doctor reports the gaps. assignee/status are grooming and lifecycle state — never set by derive/import.
